Requirement: Demonstrate a defensible decision-control layer for privileged-identity containment using synthetic data.
Ingest case records containing multi-source evidence events.
Store ground truth separately from runtime case inputs.
Assess evidence provenance integrity freshness trust diversity completeness and conflicts.
Exclude untrusted free text from model features.
Estimate compromise probability using a replaceable model.
Produce one of four bounded dispositions.
Perform independent non-model verification.
Issue case-bound action-scoped short-lived authorization tokens.
Execute only allow-listed simulated reversible actions.
Verify target state after action execution.
Generate tamper-evident audit records.
The model shall have no direct action authority.
Poisoned evidence shall block autonomous action.
Break-glass identities shall require human authority.
Assets above the criticality threshold shall not be autonomously acted upon.
Human-only actions shall be rejected from executable action sets.
No action shall execute without a valid token.
No token shall be issued without independent-verifier approval.
No success shall be declared without post-action state verification.
Authorization tokens shall be integrity protected.
Audit records shall be hash chained.
Feature and evidence claims shall trace to source event identifiers.
The POC shall not contain a production connector or production credentials.
A baseline run shall be reproducible from a documented seed.
The POC shall run offline after dependencies are installed.
The system shall emit machine-readable and human-readable outputs.
Implementation: JSONL JSON CSV and HTML reports

Requirement: The design shall be model agnostic.
Implementation: Model adapter boundary and policy separation

Requirement: Automated tests shall cover core safety invariants.
Scenario metrics shall identify behavior by benign malicious ambiguous and adversarial scenario.
Baseline limitations shall be stated with the results.
